verdict: Lead costs are rising sharply; a creative refresh is already underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 150 leads at an average cost of $14.17 per lead, but the most recent week tells a harder story: leads dropped 33% while cost per lead jumped 43%, with spend barely moving. The confirmed cause is creative fatigue on your sole active campaign — the same ads have been running long enough that the audience is tuning them out. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to reverse the efficiency slide. Your Google Business Profile held steady, adding 4% more actions this period, which provides a stable organic floor while the paid campaign is corrected.

average cost per lead this period, up sharply in the most recent week
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, directions, and site clicks

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead surged 43% week-over-week as the active campaign shows clear signs of audience fatigue — more spend is producing flat lead volume.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed this week to reset audience engagement and bring cost per lead back down.
